about_short_description.short_description: Moreta offers a digital wallet for international travelers to make payments using their phones.

product.name: Moreta Digital Wallet
product.description: A mobile app that enables international travelers to make local currency payments via QR code scanning across Southeast Asia by linking their US, UK, or EU bank accounts.

product.name: Moreta Cashback Rewards
product.description: A rewards program offering 1% cashback on every purchase made through the Moreta Digital Wallet, credited instantly with no fees.

product.name: Moreta Travel Budgeting Tools
product.description: Features within the Moreta app that allow users to track spending in real-time, set spending limits, and categorize transactions for better financial management while traveling.

product.name: Moreta Gold Membership
product.description: A subscription service offering enhanced benefits such as 2% cashback on purchases, higher instant deposit limits, and priority customer support for $9.99/month.
